question: How many people were killed in the Guerrero earthquake on January 2, 2026?

steps.content: [2026 Guerrero earthquake] On 2 January 2026, at 07:58:18 local time (13:58:18 UTC), a Mw 6.5 earthquake struck near San Marcos in the Mexican state of Guerrero. The earthquake occurred at a depth of 18 kilometres (11 mi). Two people were killed, twenty-four others were injured and hundreds of buildings were damaged as a result of the earthquake. | other articles: List of earthquakes in 2026, 2026 Colombia earthquake

The Guerrero earthquake on January 2, 2026, resulted in the deaths of two people. Additionally, twenty-four others were injured, and there was significant damage to hundreds of buildings. 

FINAL: 2 people were killed.
